description: Continue an app cost estimate by sending the user's answers or requested changes to the MVP scope, user stories, requirements, or technical specification. Pass their exact words in input_as_text, even when next_tool is send_action. Compact replies such as "1A, 2B" are valid. Preserve the user's selections; in interaction mode Review each step do not choose answers for them. In interaction mode Review each step, relay the pipe-table and wait for approval. In Run it for me, relay the table and the decision receipt, then continue. After the user picks Review each step or Run it for me, set interaction_mode to clarify_first or auto_complete on this call. Include input_as_text when their reply also contains an idea or an answer. Omit input_as_text only when the reply is just the mode. Do not use send_action or mode_select_* for that choice. If no mode is set yet and the user continues without choosing, omit interaction_mode and the server accepts clarify_first. Phrases like "Run it for me" or "auto-complete" in input_as_text switch the thread to auto_complete.

input_as_text.description: User message text; omit for a style-only interaction_mode switch.

interaction_mode.description: Interview style: clarify_first (Review each step) or auto_complete (Run it for me). Required for a style-only switch; when omitted with input_as_text, clarify_first is accepted by default.

interview_handle.description: Opaque interview handle from start_session. Pass it on every later tool.

name: send_turn
title: Continue app estimate or revise scope
